title: Arcade at home, a computer, and a doll
lede: Coleco advertised all three of its 1980s hits on national television. The commercials were uploaded by collectors; their dates are the uploaders’.

videos.title: ColecoVision: “Bring the Arcade Experience Home” (1982)
videos.caption: A launch-year spot for the console Coleco introduced in August 1982.[^1] The year is the uploader’s.

videos.title: Coleco Adam: “Is That Legal?” (1984)
videos.caption: An Adam commercial from the year Coleco cut its wholesale price from $650 to $475.[^4] The uploader supplied the year.

videos.title: Cabbage Patch Kids, Coleco toy commercial (1984)
videos.caption: From the year the line sold $540M.[^3] That year too comes from the uploader.

videos.title: From 1983: Demand for Cabbage Patch Kids causes chaos in stores
videos.caption: Archive local news footage of the first Christmas, when demand was “always exceeding the supply,” as Coleco put it.[^2]

videos.title: The Story of the ColecoVision, What Could Have Been!
videos.caption: A fan-made video history of the console. We rely on Coleco’s filings for figures.
